text:
jesse: quick sync re: Starlit private POC. they want HSM-backed keys + short-lived client certs for our private deployment. who will own the cert/key handoff?
rachel: I can own presales handoff. Need clear checklist (artifacts + preferred transport). want to avoid back-and-forth with security.
mina: Security preference: PKCS#11 with hardware attestation for production. for POC we can accept SCEP with OIDC client auth or a one-time manual CSR. must receive CA chain and attestation cert if available.
aditya: sizing note: customer quoted ~150 qps and ~1k concurrents. prelim mapping -> ~4 a100-equivalent GPUs. pricing for a 30d POC should be discounted; i'll propose reduced commit + credits.
jesse: okay list the exact artifacts we ask them to upload and the supported transfer methods. i'll send this as part of kickoff. :+1:
rachel: Draft checklist: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM details: vendor, model, firmware, PKCS#11 module path or SCEP endpoint 3) Key policy (non-exportable, usages) 4) CSR (if manual) 5) Allowed management CIDRs and jump host info 6) Bastion SSH pubkey and contact for VPN setup 7) Desired cert TTL and rotation window 8) SIEM/Syslog endpoint for audit forwarding
mina: also require attestation evidence (TPM / HSM attestation), and a PKCS#11 test vector that signs a small nonce so we can validate key operations during onboarding.
aditya: routing question: do they want model pinning to Dedicated or fallback to hosted? affects capacity & pricing. ask them to confirm.
jesse: for transport propose: A) PKCS#11 over customer VPN (preferred) B) SCEP + OIDC enrollment C) secure upload (S3 presigned or scoped SFTP) — which should we recommend?
mina: recommend A for production. allow B/C for POC only and mark them as limited (no attestation guarantees). include sample PKCS#11 commands they can run locally to generate CSR:
```
# customer runs on their HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/yourpkcs11.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --id 01 --label starlit_key
# generate CSR using pkcs11 engine
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=starlit_key;type=private" -out starlit.csr -subj "/CN=starlit-client/O=Starlit"
```
mina: we will return: short-lived client certs (24h-7d per their TTL), a revocation endpoint, and an attestation token tied to their pool.
rachel: secure transfer options: temporary S3 bucket with pre-signed PUTs + MFA delete, or SFTP user scoped to /uploads/starlit. include instructions for encrypting artifacts at rest with customer KMS key if they request.
jesse: noted. Starlit also asked for audit logs forwarded to their SIEM — add that to the checklist and clarify retention needs.
aditya: operational ask: we need to know if they allow our ephemeral CA to sign client certs for the POC or if they insist on their CA signing. impacts automation.
infra-bot: :ticket: Created INF-4991 "starlit: private POC hsm onboarding & cert transfer" - assignee: rachel - due: 3 business days - https://rwd.atlassian/INF-4991
mina: security follow-ups I'll request: SOC2 or ISO evidence if available, ATO statement for POC, and their rotation/compromise plan.
jesse: timeline ask to Starlit: please provide artifacts and chosen transfer method within 5 business days to meet a 2-week POC kickoff. I'll send the email with the checklist and the sample commands.
rachel: i'll draft the handoff email + attach the checklist and the PKCS#11 example. will update INF-4991 with customer response.
jesse: thanks team. i'll ping once they pick S3 vs SFTP. :rocket:
